title: Compact-support exchange isomorphism for geometric Frobenius
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite coefficient field $E/\Ql$ in $\Qlb$, and $\Lambda\in\{E,\Qlb\}$ with the rational/common-stage Weil-complex categories of [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. Let $X_0,Y_0$ be finite-type $k_0$-schemes and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be separated and of finite type; put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, $f=f_0\times_{k_0}k$, and let $g_X,g_Y$ be the geometric-Frobenius automorphisms. For every domain of bounded constructible objects on which the compact-support direct image and the displayed pullbacks are defined, the compact-support base-change exchange of [def-exchange-projection] for the Cartesian semilinear square $fg_X=g_Yf$,
$$
\operatorname{Ex}_!:Lg_Y^*Rf_!\longrightarrow Rf_!Lg_X^*,
$$
is a natural isomorphism. This holds after rationalization over $E$ and after passage to the common-stage $\Qlb$ category, with the coefficient-category and finite-Tor hypotheses of the underlying operations retained; no separatedness of $X_0$ or $Y_0$ is required.
